functions.label: L:VC Automatic Flight trigger VAL
functions.description: Trigger-style MCP lvar (write a numeric code to fire an action; iFly uses paired press/release codes rather than one lvar per switch). Confirmed codes: 11/12 = course selector inc/dec, 15/16 = HDG SEL button press/release (also used for TOGA per Lorby_SI's script), 31/32 = MCP altitude window down/up, 33/34 = ALT INTV, 51/52 = HDG SEL (alt report), 55/56 = ALT HOLD.

functions.label: L:VC Electrical trigger Val
functions.description: Electrical-panel trigger lvar. Value 8 = battery switch ON, value 7 = battery switch OFF (send 7 then a ~100ms pause then 7 again per one poster's working recipe).

functions.label: L:VC Miscellaneous trigger VAL
functions.description: Misc-panel trigger lvar. Values 30/31 = position/strobe lights steady vs strobe mode; values 18/19 = landing light 1 off/on; 20/21 = landing light 2 off/on (via simulated WheelUp/WheelDown on the switch).

functions.label: L:VC MFD ENG SW VAL
functions.description: MFD engine-display switch value; poster reported setting it to 10.0 to select the ENG display page.

functions.label: L:VC AILERON Trim SW VAL
functions.description: Aileron trim switch lvar. Value 0 = switch pressed (trim left example), value 10 = switch released.

functions.label: L:VC Course 1 SW VAL
functions.description: Captain-side course selector animation value, range 0-120, wraps around.

functions.label: L:VC Flight Control trigger VAL
functions.description: Flight-control trigger lvar; values 27/28 drive aileron trim left/right.

functions.label: L:VC Air Systems trigger VAL
functions.description: Air-systems trigger lvar; values 38-41 increment/decrement the FLT ALT and LAND ALT pressurization selectors.

functions.label: L:VC Window Heat 1 SW VAL
functions.description: Window-heat switch 1 position state (0/1), read before writing VC_Anti_Ice_trigger_VAL to toggle it.

functions.label: L:VC Window Heat 2 SW VAL
functions.description: Window-heat switch 2 position state (0/1).

functions.label: L:VC Window Heat 3 SW VAL
functions.description: Window-heat switch 3 position state (0/1).

functions.label: L:VC Window Heat 4 SW VAL
functions.description: Window-heat switch 4 position state (0/1).

functions.label: L:VC Anti Ice trigger VAL
functions.description: Anti-ice panel trigger lvar; the 4 window-heat switches and other anti-ice switches are driven by writing codes 7-14 to this single trigger.

functions.label: L:VC Landing Light 1 SW VAL
functions.description: Landing light 1 switch position readout, used alongside VC_Miscellaneous_trigger_VAL codes 18/19 to drive the light.

functions.label: L:WASMVAR iFly737MAX AileronTrimSwitch
functions.description: Bool. Set to 1 to trigger the aileron-trim-in-use indication/sound for the WASM gauge module.

functions.label: L:WASMVAR iFly737MAX AileronTrimSwitchRelease
functions.description: Bool. Set to 1 to trigger the aileron-trim-switch-release sound/state in the WASM gauge module.

functions.label: L:add iFly spd value
functions.description: Read-only lvar exposing the current MCP speed/Mach window value; surfaced by the third-party 'Add Lvar for iFly 737 Max8' companion module (not native to iFly itself).

functions.label: L:add iFly std status
functions.description: Read-only lvar exposing the MCP STD (standard baro) mode indication; surfaced by the third-party 'Add Lvar for iFly 737 Max8' companion module.

functions.label: L:add iFly bank value
functions.description: Writable lvar controlling the MCP bank-angle selector value; surfaced by the third-party 'Add Lvar for iFly 737 Max8' companion module.
